map.📚 深度解析：人口密度与容量计算: 📚 Deep dive: Population Density and Capacity Calculation
map.核算人口密度：人口毛密度 = 总人口 ÷ 总用地，人口净密度 = 总人口 ÷ 居: To compute population density: gross population density = total population ÷ total land use, net population density = total population ÷ residential land use, used to assess the livability of a planning district.
map.计算人均用地 = 总用地×10000 ÷ 人口，对照规范人均标准（新建城市 85: Compute per-capita land use = total land use×10000 ÷ population and check it against the per-capita code standard (85–105 m²/person for new cities, etc.) to judge whether the limit is exceeded.
map.测算人口容量：取\"按人均用地\"与\"按净密度\"两者较小值，得到适宜承载人口: Estimate population capacity: take the smaller of "by per-capita land use" and "by net density" as the appropriate carrying population.
map.人口毛密度和净密度有什么区别？: What is the difference between gross and net population density?
map.毛密度用总用地（含道路、公服、工业等）作分母，数值较小；净密度只用居住用地作分母: Gross density uses total land use (including roads, public facilities, industrial land, etc.) as the denominator, so the value is smaller; net density uses only residential land as the denominator, so the value is larger and closer to actual residential crowding. Only the two combined give a full evaluation.
map.人均建设用地标准如何取？: How is the per-capita construction land standard chosen?
map.按规划区类型：新建城市 85–105 m²/人、旧城改造 75–95、建制镇 8: By planning district type: new city 85–105 m²/person, old city redevelopment 75–95, established town 80–100, village 90–120. Below the lower limit means the density is too high; above the upper limit means the land use is too coarse.
